clauses.quote: The parties agree to cooperate by meeting with the mediator promptly and making available at the mediator’s request any public records and data pertinent to the issues at impasse.
clauses.notes: Joint procedural obligation; subject is collective. Assigned management as default protected party for joint framework clauses.

clauses.quote: both parties shall make such further efforts to reach agreement as mutually agreed to by both negotiating teams.
The rules of procedure listed in this article may be changed at any time by mutual consent of both teams.
clauses.notes: Passive construction; joint discretion to modify procedures.

clauses.quote: The teacher with a grievance must first attempt to resolve it informally by discussing the issue with their direct supervisor (school level principal or district office director) within ten working days after the teacher became aware of the act or condition upon which the grievance is based.
clauses.notes: Procedural duty on employee to initiate informal resolution first.

clauses.quote: The principal or district office director shall have up to 10 working days after learning of the grievance to consider the matter
clauses.subject_text: The principal or district office director
clauses.notes: Grants management time/discretion to review initial grievance.

clauses.quote: The principal or district office director shall give the principal’s or district office director’s answer orally to the employee.
clauses.subject_text: The principal or district office director
clauses.notes: Management duty to provide oral response at step one.

clauses.quote: the teacher may file the grievance with the principal or district office director in writing within ten working days after receiving the answer in step one.
clauses.notes: Right to escalate to written step if informal resolution fails.

clauses.quote: The written grievance shall describe the nature of the grievance and the facts giving rise to it;
clauses.notes: Formal content requirement for grievance filing.

clauses.quote: The written grievance shall note the provisions alleged to be violated, misinterpreted, or misapplied and the position of the teacher with respect to such provisions;
clauses.notes: Formal content requirement for grievance filing.

clauses.quote: The written grievance shall state the specific remedy requested to resolve the grievance.
clauses.notes: Formal content requirement for grievance filing.
